subject: Life Skills

source.subtopic: What plants need to grow; growing a plant from a seed

show.line: Plant a seed! Give it soil, water and sunlight. Watch it grow!

rounds.prompt: What does a plant need to grow?
What else does a plant need?
Seed, sprout, small plant, and then?
Which part takes up water from the soil?
Why do we need plants? Name one thing they give us.

rounds.story: Thato puts a bean seed in a dark cupboard with no water. Will it grow well?
rounds.praise: No! It needs water and light.

hints: Plants need soil, water, air and light.
A seed grows into a plant.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I planted a seed.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Seeds need water to grow.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Water and sun help it grow!

parent_line: Knows what plants need to grow and why we need plants.
